title: John 1:1 — letters and words formula giving 2.7183E x 10^40 (e)
summary: Under the heading John 1:1 (English and Greek), a formula — (number of letters x product of letters) divided by (number of words x product of words) — worked out as (52 x 8,436,251,456,259,110 followed by 24 zeros) divided by (17 x 949,302,241,399,839 followed by 21 zeros) = 2.7183E x 10^40, which the slide equates with the constant e.

text.text: (Number of Letters x Product of Letters) divided by (Number of Words x Product of Words) =
= logₑ X x 10^40 or e x 10^40
